positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Experimentation Platform

- Implemented UX improvements and solutions on A/B testing tools for thousands of internal users
- Developed metric regression detection tools to escalate experiments based on different criteria and thresholds
- Drove syncs with external customers to establish communication and streamline feedback at a regular cadence


Facebook Marketplace

- Developed in mobile dev environments in React Native and Hack/PHP
- Led engineering workstreams to execute in a fast paced environment
- Implemented server side rendered product recommendations on Newsfeed
- Modified and developed Marketplace components

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Windows Update UX

- Implement features in the Windows 10/11 Settings App: Update & Security page
- Create and improve dialog and toast notifications for Windows 10 Updates
- Modify and add business logic using underlying API's for Update UX
- Introduce and alter code in the backend service of Windows 10/11 Updates
- Engage in daily VM testing environment for code change validation

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Reorganized the Windows Update History using the Universal Windows Platform. Increased my knowledge of application development by gaining experience in Universal Windows App development. Improved my skills in XAML and UI concepts while implementing business logic in C++. Gained exposure to internal tools such as source control, debuggers, build environments, and virtual machine testing.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed a project called "Smart Data Mining System (SDMS)"​. Created and modified UI's using Bootstrap, implemented Single Page Application (SPA) using AngularJS and jQuery, built RESTful services with ASP.NET Web API and created stored procedures on MS SQL Server.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped students understand challenging object oriented programming concepts in Java and worked as a team with other teaching assistants to run lab sessions smoothly.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Learned to use Microsoft Visual Studio and Microsoft SQL Server, created new functionalities to local project management software using WPF, and developed and modified data tables and stored procedures using SQL and entity relationship diagrams.

projects.title: Voice Over Web Browser (Vowb)
projects.description: Worked with team of 6 to create a convenient voice chat client on the web browser. Implemented with Node.js platform. Personal work includes utilizing Router class to implement routing, communicating with data access layer, sending data back to client in JSON format, and using Ajax methods in making http requests and handlers.
